LEARN BEFORE WE SCALE

A small pilot.
A better evening.

LastBite connects students and young professionals within 3 km of Ahmedabad bakeries and cafés with closing-hour surplus.

THE VALUE

₹250+ of food for ₹99

A low-cost surprise for you; a chance for partners to recover value from surplus. Pickup only, with no delivery fee.

THE ITERATION

More time to collect

This prototype adopts the PDF’s proposed v2: a 90-minute pickup window, a visible per-vendor quota and early reservation instead of a first-reply WhatsApp queue.

NEXT EXPERIMENT

Two weeks, six partners

Proposed targets: at least 85% pickup and 50% repeat purchase. Test willingness to pay ₹99, reliable nightly supply and partner willingness to join.

EVIDENCE STATUS

Still to be tested

The supplied report marks its numbers as draft figures. They are not verified results. Demo reservations are usability signals, not real sales or field validation.

Pickup: 8:30–10:00 pmReserve by 6 pm on your selected collection day.
Cancellation and missed pickup policy

Cancel before pickup starts at 8:30 pm IST to release your bag. If a partner cannot fulfil a bag, it is marked vendor-cancelled. Missed pickup is recorded after 10 pm; safe, unclaimed food may be donated. No payment or refund occurs in this demo. A real pilot must agree its refund terms before taking money.

Demo only. No payment is collected. The real pilot requires confirmed partners and a working payment/refund policy.
